verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an agentic search mode in which an LLM plans a natural-language request, extracting deterministic filters and splitting it into sub-searches. Its official MCP server lets users operate it in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex and similar clients, with no code or API key required. Hands-on community reports show natural-language queries like "red high top sneakers under $40" returning irrelevant items and ignoring the price limit, which tempers confidence in execution. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that agentic mode reliably honors natural-language constraints, and natural-language control beyond search and lookup (e.g. managing price-tracking subscriptions conversationally).
